name: The Iron Heart
description: An undercover agent goes on a dangerous mission to bring down a crime ring. Fueled by a bitter and painful past, he along with his allies faces the grueling task that will challenge his resolve and strength.

credits_cast.character: Apollo Adelantar / Olimpio "Tisoy" Custodio / Aries dela Torre
credits_cast.name: Richard Gutierrez

videos.title: Core of Iron
videos.overview: Taking his father’s words to heart, Apollo uses his unexplainable strength for good. One day, their simple life takes a dark turn following a violent encounter with drug addicts. Apollo later receives an enticing offer from a total stranger.

videos.title: The Calling
videos.overview: Apollo gets forced to choose between love and duty as he receives his first mission as a top secret agent. Amid his preparations, his strength and principles are put to the test when a group of unknown men abducts him.

videos.title: Hit the Mission Road
videos.overview: As part of his mission to bring down Tatsulok, Apollo throws his promising life away and enters jail to penetrate the notorious drug syndicate. Following her painful reunion with Apollo, Cassandra receives unexpected houseguests.

videos.title: The Breakout
videos.overview: Apollo manages to worm his way into Tatsulok following his escape from prison. Not wanting her sister to experience what she went through, Cassandra takes Lia in when their mother decides to leave again.

videos.title: Up the Ladder
videos.overview: Apollo foils Sol's mission. Soon, the secret agent finds an opportunity to work his way up when the unsuspecting Janus chooses him to participate in combat and appease their enraged bosses.

videos.title: Inked
videos.overview: Apollo displays his impressive fighting skills during the combat, capturing the Engineer’s interest and getting himself the official Tatsulok mark. The attention Apollo is receiving, however, sparks jealousy among one of the syndicate members.

videos.title: Rising Leader
videos.overview: Apollo rises through the ranks but at the expense of his personal life as Cassandra tries to start anew without him. The dela Torre's celebration of success turns into Priam's worst nightmare when the undercover agent strikes against them.

videos.title: Period of Peace
videos.overview: As the word gets around that the Engineer is dead, Priam lets the CIB raid his businesses easily while he plans his next move. Believing that his mission is finally over, Apollo goes back to Cassandra, asking to give their love another chance.

videos.title: Payback
videos.overview: As Apollo begins planning for their future together, Cassandra volunteers to join him in his meeting with Helen. However, all hell breaks loose when a vengeful Priam decides to strike back following his son's death.

videos.title: Cassandra's End
videos.overview: Tatsulok wreaks havoc as the grieving Priam exacts ruthless revenge for Jason's demise. To Apollo's horror, Cassandra gets caught in the chaos, giving the undercover agent another reason to take down the syndicate.

videos.title: Assembly of the Wicked
videos.overview: With a heavy heart, Apollo returns to the syndicated world with a mission to end the evil that Priam is. The Engineer calls in reinforcements to make sure that his son's killer will pay. Eros is eager to impress Priam and replace Jason as his heir.

videos.title: The Manhunt
videos.overview: Suspicious of his own men's loyalty, Priam orders Tatsulok's high-ranking members to find the person responsible for Jason's death. Venus ensures her father’s safety inside prison and recalls how she started making a living through schemes.

videos.title: A New Task
videos.overview: As Apollo showcases his impressive skills in combat, John begins to see the undercover agent as a threat to his position and excludes him from the group's important task. Eros brews a sinister plan to win over Priam's trust.

videos.title: First Skirmish
videos.overview: Wanting to get her father out of prison, Venus banks on her trickery to earn money for a lawyer. Apollo clashes with Eros as they both go after the shipment, while Nyx grabs the opportunity to outsmart John's group.

videos.title: In His Arms
videos.overview: John lashes out at Poseidon upon learning that he failed to carry out their group's mission. Apollo gets into a fight with their leader when the latter tries to take advantage of a woman who turns out to be Bungo's daughter.

videos.title: New Pair of Eyes
videos.overview: Poseidon finds himself at the receiving end of his boss’ wrath after Apollo saved Venus from John. Priam assigns a secret ace to be his new pair of eyes in the investigation of Jason’s death.

videos.title: Roles to Undertake
videos.overview: Apollo urges Venus to quit her work in the fighting arena. Hermes gets a lead in the investigation that points the bombing to CIB. Eros receives a rewarding consequence after facing the Engineer's fury for crossing John's group.

videos.title: Delos
videos.overview: Venus grows more determined to get Bungo out of prison after learning of his worsening health condition. Apollo pursues a new lead about Priam's illegal operations, but an oblivious Poseidon insists on tagging along with him.

videos.title: The Bug
videos.overview: Apollo grows suspicious of Delos' dire agricultural state and soon sets out to kill Priam despite Helen's warning. However, the undercover agent chances upon Eric, a young scientist trying to escape from armed men.

videos.title: Uncovering Evidence
videos.overview: Learning about the cause of Delos' dying root crops, Apollo thinks of a plan to save a group of young scientists being held captive in a laboratory. Eros senses something amiss with Arcadia's new casino player.

videos.title: Plan of Action
videos.overview: Enraged over Eric's betrayal, Damon gives the other scientists an ultimatum to complete their task. Eros attempts to uncover the truth behind Hermes' hidden motives. Apollo resolves to fight for the greater good.

videos.title: A Day of Trade Offs
videos.overview: Venus shows Eros what she can do for him and asks for a huge favor. Penelope gets the experiment done in hopes of freedom, only to fall for Damon's lies. Unknown to the enslaved scientists, help is coming their way.

videos.title: One Wins, Some Fail
videos.overview: After saving the scientists, Apollo sets the laboratory on fire in a bid to stop the disastrous bug experiment from materializing. Venus makes use of her charms and wit to get information from Hermes.

videos.title: Realizations
videos.overview: Venus refuses to give up on her deal with Eros. Priam fumes upon learning of Damon's failed bug experiment, instructing Hero to find the traitor in their organization. Poseidon grows suspicious of Apollo's true motive in coming to Delos.

videos.title: Dose of Your Own Medicine
videos.overview: Apollo saves Penelope and the group of farmers from Damon as the evil landowner exacts revenge for Tatsulok's failed bug experiment. Venus finds herself in a tight spot when Hermes catches her hiding in his van.

videos.title: Covert Identity
videos.overview: As thanks for defeating Damon and protecting the people of Delos, Penelope gives Apollo a special gift. Eros attempts to get the truth out of Hermes by challenging the latter to a game of poker.

videos.title: Caught Up
videos.overview: A bloody confrontation ensues between Hermes and Eros after the former CIB agent gained a piece of evidence against the casino owner. Much to Nyx's distress, Eros receives an urgent summon.

videos.title: Interrogation
videos.overview: Eros faces interrogation as Hermes' death leads Priam to suspect him. Venus' attempt to improve her father's living conditions in prison backfires. Apollo receives an unexpected visit from Helen.

videos.title: Promises
videos.overview: Venus confronts Eros about their deal. While Apollo faces problems at home, the casino owner-slash-secret agent slowly earns Priam's trust and gets tapped for an important task. Juno breaks into tears upon seeing Hermes' lifeless body.

videos.title: The Other Agent
videos.overview: Bent on completing his mission as a secret agent at all costs, Eros takes charge of John's group. Tatsulok's remaining high-ranking members gird their loins against the traitor lurking freely in their organization.

videos.title: The Engineer's Second Soldier
videos.overview: Tensions start to rise as Apollo's group ends up under Eros' supervision. While Priam pressures Athena to perfect Tatsulok's new experiment as soon as possible, Apollo vows to bring them down by exposing their illegal activities.

videos.title: Warnings and Red Flags
videos.overview: Juno vows to avenge Hermes' death. Priam's unusual behavior alarms Tatsulok's high-ranking members. While Eros zeroes in on Apollo, the oblivious undercover agent sets out to thwart Athernity's sinister plans.

videos.title: Connected After All
videos.overview: As a senator presses her to unmask CIB's agent in Tatsulok, Helen puts her career on the line to keep Apollo's mission hidden. Eros learns of Venus' connection with Apollo. Selene asks Priam about his secret plans.

videos.title: Business Continuity
videos.overview: Apollo saves Helen from a group of men trying to abduct her. Despite the break-in, Athena carries on with Priam's plans. Eros seeks Venus' expertise to obtain information about Olimpio, only to get confronted with Hermes' death.

videos.title: A Time to Phish
videos.overview: Eros tries to persuade a reluctant Venus to accept his new job offer, while Apollo learns pieces of information about his boss. Delia finds ways to raise money for Athernity's million-worth product.

videos.title: The Magic Drip
videos.overview: Helen and her team storm Athena's building to look for pieces of evidence against Athernity. Wanting to ensure the safety of his aunt who is about to receive the magic drip, Apollo goes against Helen's orders and takes matters into his own hands.

videos.title: What Comes After
videos.overview: Apollo infiltrates Athernity to save Delia and its other clients from the magic drip, while Athena faces Priam's wrath as the Engineer's plans fail anew. Nyx grows alarmed at the sight of Hermes' van in Arcadia.

videos.title: Need to Know More
videos.overview: Helen puts the senator on the spot as he confronts her over the raid operation against Athernity. While Eros asks around regarding Olimpio, Venus approaches the unsuspecting agent. Juno sets out to seek justice for Hermes' death.

videos.title: The Snitch
videos.overview: While Eros inspects Athernity’s office to investigate the aftermath of the snitch's intrusion, Apollo sneaks into Athena’s home to plant some bugs around to spy. Meanwhile, Athena reports some good news to Priam.

videos.title: Apollo
videos.overview: Apollo drops by Venus' place, but he soon rushes home after hearing bad news about Lia. While the undercover agent deals with family matters, Venus stumbles upon the door to Apollo's personal life.

videos.title: Hurt Not My Famiy
videos.overview: Apollo walks on eggshells as his family spends time with Venus. Just when Venus thought she had already witnessed enough family drama, Delia suffers a heart attack and gets rushed to the hospital. A violent confrontation ensues between Nyx and Juno.

videos.title: Sudden Sincerity
videos.overview: Venus begins to see Apollo in a different light, only to overhear his conversation with Hector. With an ace up her sleeve, Juno tries to strike a deal with Eros regarding Priam and Tatsulok.

videos.title: No More Guesswork
videos.overview: Apollo tries to confirm his suspicions about Venus until help amid danger pushes the young woman to confess her true motive in approaching him. Juno proves her sincerity to Eros, only to get outsmarted by the sly casino owner.

videos.title: Taking Measures
videos.overview: Venus resolves to keep Apollo's true identity a secret from Eros and tries to quit the job, but her boss gives her a new task. Determined to seek justice for Delia and the other victims, Apollo devises a plan to stop Athernity's evil schemes.

videos.title: As Feelings Linger
videos.overview: Bearing in mind Priam's life-long goal, Helen recalls a painful memory from the past. Venus becomes smitten with Apollo's genuine nature, while the undercover agent prepares for his mission against Athernity.

videos.title: Calm Before
videos.overview: Eros assigns Apollo to supervise an operation on the very same day as Athernity's party, leaving the latter in a pickle. More troubles arise for Apollo when Venus suddenly appears, begging to tag along. Meanwhile, Selene attempts to impress Priam.

videos.title: Getting There
videos.overview: Venus insists on helping Apollo execute his plan against Athernity despite his efforts to keep her out of harm's way. At the party, tension builds up between Athena and Eros.

videos.title: Atherinity Night
videos.overview: With Venus and Poseidon's help, Apollo manages to sneak into Athernity's special night to look for evidence against the magic drip. There, Apollo comes to blows with Adonis' right-hand man. Eros carries out his own investigation about Athena.

videos.title: More Heat than Light
videos.overview: Eros hunts down the snitch while still keeping tabs on Apollo. A clash soon ensues between the two oblivious secret agents, leaving Nyx wounded. Meanwhile, Venus and Poseidon face serious danger when a fleeing Athena discovers their deceit.

videos.title: Teaming Up
videos.overview: While Venus obtains help from a stranger who turns out to be Hermes' wife, Apollo gets severely wounded as he wrestles with Athena. A furious Eros arrives at the barracks looking for Tisoy and Poseidon.

videos.title: Out of the Bag
videos.overview: Apollo expresses his gratitude to Juno for nursing him back to health, but soon gets taken aback when she mentions Tatsulok. Meanwhile, Eros wastes no time in reporting to Priam about his encounter with the secret agent.

videos.title: Safekeeping
videos.overview: Apollo defies Eros' orders and confronts Helen about CIB's other agents in Tatsulok. As Selene panics over the Athernity owner's disappearance, Athena does the unexpected to ensure that the organization's secret remains under wraps.

videos.title: Didn't See That Coming
videos.overview: Not wanting to waste time, Priam appoints a trusted ally to carry on Athena's unfinished serum project. Venus continues to cover for Apollo upon learning more about Tatsulok through Juno's eyes.

videos.title: Mad Man's Wrath
videos.overview: Unaware of Eros' motives, Apollo gets summoned for a mission. Nyx confronts Venus about her dealings with Eros, only to find themselves in the middle of Adonis' war against the Tatsulok spy. Hero learns about Bunggo's special arrangement in prison.

videos.title: Agent vs. Agent
videos.overview: Uncovering the truth about each other's identities, Apollo and Eros engage in a bloody skirmish until the news of Venus and Nyx's abduction reaches them. A furious Selene reports Adonis' reckless way of finding the snitch to Priam.

videos.title: Of Warnings and Cautions
videos.overview: Apollo and Eros form an unlikely pair as they rescue Venus and Nyx from their abductors. Later, Eros finds himself torn between Priam's orders and Apollo's offer of alliance. A masked man threatens the CIB to reveal their snitch in Tatsulok.

videos.title: Battle of Nerves
videos.overview: Tatsulok's massive manhunt for the snitch puts CIB and their secret agents in a tough situation. Wanting to change her fate and stand up for what is right, Venus resigns from her job. A new friend welcomes Troy into the world of easy money.

videos.title: Inceptive Blast
videos.overview: Following his attempt to call for a truce with Eros, Apollo hatches a plan now that Adonis is beginning to wreak havoc. Troy, meanwhile, witnesses how his new friend operates as an internet troll.

videos.title: Two Agents Save
videos.overview: Helen is called to a Senate inquiry as Apollo and Eros race against time to stop Adonis from triggering another deadly explosion. Troy begins to have second thoughts about his new job.

videos.title: Madness
videos.overview: While Apollo faces Adonis and his men all by himself, Eros tries to save the people at the port by warning them about the bomb. Priam, meanwhile, orders Romulo to get rid of Adonis.

videos.title: The Moment of Encounter
videos.overview: In a risky attempt to come face to face with Priam, Apollo surrenders himself and admits to killing Adonis. Meanwhile, Nyx demands the truth from Eros as she confronts him about his wound.

videos.title: The New Boss
videos.overview: Priam unknowingly falls for Tisoy's tricks and gives him a chance to prove his worth after Eros failed to present the snitch. Venus finds herself in danger when a group of Tatsulok members comes chasing after her. Eros' secret boss is revealed.

videos.title: On One's Guard
videos.overview: Still doubtful of her friend, Nyx tries to track Eros' whereabouts in a bid to discover the truth about him. Upon learning of Venus' terrifying encounter with some Tatsulok members, Apollo warns her against making contact with Eros and Juno.

videos.title: Out with the Dead, In with the New
videos.overview: A new boss comes in as Tatsulok gathers together to hold a funeral for Athena. While Venus receives an unexpected call concerning her father, Hero learns about Bungo's connection to his organization.

videos.title: Latest Ace
videos.overview: Apollo seizes an opportunity to uncover Priam's secret project when the Engineer gathers the Tatsulok members to give them reassurance. Meanwhile, Eros deals with a jealous Nyx amid his plans to get on Selene's side.

videos.title: Torture
videos.overview: Apollo and Eros find themselves in a tight spot after receiving unexpected orders from their respective bosses. Bungo suffers at the hands of some Tatsulok members who are hunting the mole inside the organization.

videos.title: Break-In
videos.overview: Wanting to impress their respective bosses, Apollo and Eros find a way to steal Selene's and Orcus' luxury cars. This, however, leads to a confrontation between the two Tatsulok groups. Hero continues to torture Bungo inside the prison.

videos.title: Brewing
videos.overview: Venus confronts an inmate whom she believes to be the person behind Bungo's wounded state. Along with Delia, Hector grows worried about Troy when he fails to come home following their heated argument.

videos.title: Schemes
videos.overview: After slugging it out in a fist fight arranged by their bosses, Apollo and Eros learn about what happened to Bungo. With Venus relocated to a safer place, the undercover agent resolves to get the clobbered prisoner out of jail.

videos.title: Plan and Rescue
videos.overview: While Apollo tries to find ways to sneak Bungo out of prison, Venus discovers Tatsulok's horrifying plan against her father. Maia warns Troy about his new friends upon learning that he ran away from home.

videos.title: All Hands
videos.overview: Apollo and Eros finalize their plan to save Bungo. Hector and Delia learn about Troy’s suspicious activities. While worrying about her father’s safety, Venus gets an unexpected visitor while staying at Eros’ rest house.

videos.title: All Ears
videos.overview: Venus gets to know Nyx a little deeper when the latter surprisingly pours her heart out about her feelings for Eros. Taking the explosion as his signal, Bungo attempts to escape from prison. Elsewhere, Priam arrives for a mysterious meeting.

videos.title: Saving One Man's Life
videos.overview: Apollo's elaborate plan of rescuing Bungo succeeds amid the CIB agents' intense face-off with the Tatsulok members. Bent on finding out what his son has been up to, Hector decides to follow Troy.

videos.title: For A Taste of Freedom
videos.overview: Waking up out of prison, Bungo thanks Tisoy for saving his life and protecting Venus. Burning with rage after getting scolded by Priam for failing to accomplish his mission, Hero pulls out all the stops as he sets out to find the escapee.

videos.title: New Beginnings Turning to Endings
videos.overview: Apollo goes back to his Tatsulok duties following an emotional farewell between him and Venus. Bungo and his daughter, on the other hand, prepare to start with a clean slate.

videos.title: A Daughter's Pain
videos.overview: Venus and Bungo continue to run for their lives as Hero's men go after them. The chase ends in tragedy when Hero catches Bungo, making the poor man taste the ruthlessness of a Tatsulok member.

videos.title: A Moment of Grief
videos.overview: Hector and Troy incidentally meet at Bungo's wake, giving the older man a chance to talk to his son. After her father's burial, Venus vows to make Bungo's killer pay by working with Apollo in bringing Tatsulok down.

videos.title: Retribution
videos.overview: While Venus treads on Hero's heels, Apollo prepares to take down Bungo's killer on his own. Pressured by Priam's high expectations of him, Echo wastes no time in perfecting his new drug.

videos.title: Change of Plans
videos.overview: With his finger on the trigger and Hero locked in his crosshairs, Apollo recalls how violence and lack of morals caused the untimely deaths of his loved ones. Venus lands a job at The Narcissus.

videos.title: Father and Son Dispute
videos.overview: Eros overhears something suspicious while delivering Tatsulok's funds to Selene. Learning about Hector's doubts on The Narcissus' operations, Apollo vows to save Troy from imminent danger.

videos.title: Enter the Narcissus
videos.overview: Apollo enters the dark and addicting clubbing world of Echo and wastes no time in trying to gain the latter's trust. Eros, meanwhile, sneaks into Selene's house in an attempt to uncover the secret she has been hiding in her private room.

videos.title: Side Job
videos.overview: While Apollo confirms that the vape juice from Echo's club contains psychedelic drugs, Venus continues to keep an eye on Hero while observing the club's guests. Echo arrives at Orcus' shop with a luxury car in exchange for Apollo's services.

videos.title: Listening In
videos.overview: Thanks to the bug he installed at Selene’s place, Eros learns of Apollo's involvement in Echo's upcoming big transaction. Troy returns to The Narcissus and meets Daphne who offers him the coveted vape.

videos.title: Sudden Changes
videos.overview: Sudden changes force Apollo to adapt and improvise as the day of Echo’s transaction draws near. Poseidon gets urged by his father to return to whatever unfinished business he has. Selene grows impatient as he continues to monitor Janus.

videos.title: Danger Ahead
videos.overview: Eros prepares for his and Apollo's plan, unaware that Nyx is determined to uncover his lies. Maia discovers the secret of The Narcissus upon seeing Troy and Cronus enter the club in broad daylight.

videos.title: When Things Go "North"
videos.overview: While Apollo struggles to confirm the exact location of Echo's drug exchange, Eros gears himself up for their plan, unaware that Nyx is tailing him. Venus finds a way to gather evidence of illegal acts inside The Narcissus.

videos.title: Too Much to Handle
videos.overview: Despite the obstacles thrown their way, Apollo and Eros manage to make their plan work by switching trucks. Things end in bloodshed at The Narcissus as the partygoers succumb to the destructive effects of the wrongly distributed drug.

videos.title: Catching Echo
videos.overview: A gunfight erupts between Echo's group and Mr. Villamor's men after discovering the absence of the promised drug. Later, Eros tries to finish the job without leaving a trace, only to be caught unawares by the arrival of another Tatsulok member.

videos.title: Part of the Plan
videos.overview: Getting wind of what happened to Echo’s transaction, Engineer orders his men to look for Tisoy. Apollo strengthens his resolve to push through with his mission as he loses blood following his encounter with the authorities.

videos.title: Aftermath
videos.overview: While Eros provides Nyx with an alibi, Apollo tries to protect his identity by narrating Echo's foiled transaction and their encounter with CIB to Priam. Maia, Troy, and Cronus decide to seek professional help to recover from their trauma.

videos.title: What Really Happened
videos.overview: A new position at Metafora welcomes Apollo following his seemingly heroic stunts to protect Echo. A positive change in Janus' vital signs renews Selene's hope in finding out the identity of the snitch.

videos.title: What Surprised Them
videos.overview: Apollo gets to spend some time away from his Tatsulok duties, unaware of the shocking situation waiting for him at Metafora. With orders from Priam, Hero leads a team to shut down Echo’s drug lab.

videos.title: When Everybody is on the Move
videos.overview: Apollo arrives in the nick of time to save Poseidon's skin from Orcus. Priam resorts to threats in order to settle Echo's case. Puzzled about the mysterious shell Hermes left behind, Juno tries to crack its code with all her might.

videos.title: Who Finds What
videos.overview: Apollo informs Helen about his plan to replace Hero as Priam’s right hand. Juno asks Venus to help her decode Hermes’ puzzle. Eros spots Hero’s men transporting a large sum of money.

videos.title: When Someone Knows
videos.overview: A new team is formed as Apollo, Venus, Poseidon, and Juno put their heads together in an attempt to uncover the meaning behind the shell's inscription. Eros takes advantage of his new assignment to learn more about Selene's secret patient.

videos.title: Hyperion Virus
videos.overview: Janus wakes up from coma wanting to know Selene’s plans for him. Hero finds a mysterious flash drive inside his car. Priam gives a name to the revolutionary virus as his group nears the completion of its antidote.

videos.title: Bringing the Pieces Together
videos.overview: Apollo's plan to pit Orcus and Hero against each other starts to work. Eros finds himself on the verge of having his cover blown as Nyx pieces things together from her investigation. Venus and Juno find a lead on Priam's secret project.

videos.title: About to Sink
videos.overview: Eros expresses his worry over Venus' plan to deal with Captain Nebres herself. Venus, on the other hand, persuades Apollo to teach her how to fight. Troy goes back home after a heated argument with Cronus.

videos.title: Venus 2.0
videos.overview: Eros is left speechless when Nyx accepts Selene’s offer to manage her resort, unaware of the real motive behind his right hand’s move. Apollo trains Venus how to fight as part of the latter’s goal to bring Tatsulok down.

videos.title: The Boat is Sinking
videos.overview: Orcus and Hero try to frame up each other. Venus pushes through with her own plan against Captain Nebres, taking Apollo and Eros by surprise as they resolve to take down the same enemy.

videos.title: Attempt Thwarted
videos.overview: Things get out of hand as Venus' plan against Captain Nebres goes awry, putting her life in grave danger. This leads Apollo, Eros, Juno, and Poseidon to take action and come to Venus' rescue.

videos.title: Committed to the Job
videos.overview: Apollo and Eros try to squeeze some information out of Captain Nebres about Priam's secret project. An unlikely team is formed as Venus, Juno, and Poseidon resolve to join Apollo and Eros in their mission to take down Tatsulok.

videos.title: Putting the Hero Down
videos.overview: Apollo and his newly-formed team arrive in Palermo Island and soon receive an unexpected welcome from the locals. Back at Metafora, a scheming Orcus manipulates Selene into believing that Hero is a traitor.

videos.title: A Father's Story
videos.overview: Priam relocates his lab to avoid the snitch. Terro stuns Apollo with his revelation about the latter's identity and connection to the Iron Heart project. Troy makes efforts to reconnect with his family.

videos.title: What's Left Behind
videos.overview: Despite some unanswered questions, Apollo's recent discovery fuels his determination to take down Priam and Tatsulok. Cronus' attempt to stop Troy from making an exposé about the troll farm ends up in a fight.

videos.title: Retaliation
videos.overview: Apollo and Eros watch things go according to their plan as Hero and Orcus confront each other and fight to the death. Soon, however, Apollo is forced to go after Hero, while Eros deals with Orcus.

videos.title: Justice Served
videos.overview: Venus thanks Apollo and Eros for avenging Bungo’s death. Engineer decides to head back after getting wind of Hero’s tragic fate. Cronus receives a warning from one of his colleagues as Troy’s exposé sets the internet abuzz.

videos.title: Connecting the Dots
videos.overview: As he tries to get to the bottom of Hero's death through Selene and Orcus, Priam starts to have a hunch about the snitch. While cops raid the troll farm's office, Troy and Cronus get chased by unknown men.

videos.title: The Janus that Got Away
videos.overview: Janus finds the perfect opportunity to break free from Selene’s clutches. Hector arrives just in time to save Troy and Cronus from Freyja's men. A pair of vengeful eyes secretly watches Apollo from afar.

videos.title: Finders and Seekers
videos.overview: Selene hatches a plan to capture Janus and consequently expose the identity of the snitch. Janus, on the other hand, tails Apollo's friends and family as he plots his revenge. Juno discovers another mysterious item among Hermes' files.

videos.title: Behind the Charity Gala
videos.overview: While Janus attempts to strike a deal with Priam, Selene proceeds with her plan to smoke the elusive man out through a charity gala. Following the cryptic directions from Hermes' tap card, Juno ends up within her late husband's secret den.

videos.title: Expected Vacancy
videos.overview: Tisoy is taken aback when Venus arrives at the charity gala. After summoning all the invited Tatsulok members, Engineer makes a very important proposition to anyone who wants to take the spot Hero left.

videos.title: Taking the Bait
videos.overview: Tension rises among the candidates for Hero's position as Priam tests their resolve and loyalty, unaware that it is all part of the Engineer's much bigger plan. Delia and Lia find themselves in danger as Janus begins his evil plan against Apollo.

videos.title: Out of the Bag
videos.overview: Priam finally confirms his suspicion about Tisoy being the snitch and immediately orders for the latter's capture. Apollo, on the other hand, rushes to rescue Delia and Lia from Janus.

videos.title: The Chase Begins
videos.overview: After accepting Janus' offer, Priam wastes no time in exposing the identity of the snitch to the whole of Tatsulok. With no other way to save his family, Apollo lets himself be at the mercy of Janus.

videos.title: Rampage
videos.overview: Janus proves to be a tough opponent as he continues to terrorize Delia and Lia after getting clobbered by Tisoy. Juno finds a way to stall the Tatsulok members hunting Apollo down. Engineer grows suspicious of Eros and Poseidon.

videos.title: The Mission is Over
videos.overview: After his men failed to capture Tisoy, Priam orders Orcus and Selene to pull out all the stops to catch the snitch alive. Apollo spirals down into dejection as his loved ones continue to suffer because of his duty.

videos.title: Grief
videos.overview: Apollo is left helpless when Helen relieves him from all his duties as a secret CIB agent. The hunt for Tisoy continues as Priam and the rest of Tatsulok exhaust every possible way and lead to find the snitch.

videos.title: Gone Rogue
videos.overview: Despite Helen's orders, Apollo stands firm in his resolve to exact revenge on Priam and Tatsulok no matter what it takes. While Nyx remains suspicious of him, Eros finds himself conflicted upon receiving an unexpected advice from Menandro.

videos.title: Tipped Off
videos.overview: Priam considers setting a trap in a bid to catch Apollo. Venus and Poseidon find themselves in danger as some Tatsulok members prove to be adamant in tracking them and Tisoy down.

videos.title: The Next Phase
videos.overview: Juno arrives just in time to help Apollo, Venus, and Poseidon escape from Orcus' group and later leads her allies into Hermes' secret den. With Apollo's mission compromised, Helen is left with no choice but to order his capture.

videos.title: Done Brewing the Plot
videos.overview: Despite losing the government’s support, Apollo resolves to face Priam head on. Eros urges Nyx to stop tracking down Venus, but to no avail. The convoy transferring Echo to another detention facility gets ambushed.

videos.title: Bad News Comes in Twos
videos.overview: Cronus finds a safe way to get in touch with Venus and Apollo. Determined to capture Tisoy once and for all, Priam and the rest of Tatsulok lay out a trap that is sure to alarm the elusive snitch.

videos.title: An Honorable Demise
videos.overview: Priam's wickedness reaches extreme heights as he sends a devastating message to enrage Tisoy. Fueled by anger and his determination to bring down Tatsulok, Apollo resolves to finally face Engineer.

videos.title: Bloodshed
videos.overview: Gunfight ensues as Apollo faces Priam and the rest of Tatsulok who are all eager to take down the snitch with their own hands. Venus, Juno, and Poseidon arrive to help their ally fight Engineer's trusted soldiers.

videos.title: Retreat
videos.overview: The authorities arrive just as Apollo reveals to Priam that he knows about the Iron Heart project. Later, an unexpected ally comes to Juno, Poseidon, and a wounded Venus' rescue.

videos.title: What Is To Come
videos.overview: Priam orders his top followers to find more test subjects for the Iron Heart project and prevent Tisoy from getting near it. After filling the void left by Helen at the CIB, Menandro issues a stern warning against Engineer.

videos.title: Meeting the New Deputy Director
videos.overview: Priam's desire to capture Apollo gets stronger as he sets his sights on finding out the whole truth about the Iron Heart project. Apollo, on the other hand, finally recovers and comes face-to-face with Menandro.

videos.title: Apollo 5
videos.overview: Apollo, Venus, Poseidon, Juno, and Eros officially form the group Apollo 5 at the headquarters. While Selene gives Eros the task to gather human test subjects, Apollo wastes no time in devising a plan to stop Priam's Iron Heart project.

videos.title: Failed Mission
videos.overview: Selene and Orcus' attempt to fish for more information from Aphro about the Iron Heart project remains fruitless. Believing that the coast is clear, Apollo's team sets out to abduct Aphro, unaware that Echo got wind of their plan.

videos.title: When Information is the Key
videos.overview: Apollo urges Eros to use Nyx to get more information about Priam and the Iron Heart project, leaving the other Tatsulok mole conflicted. Troy and Cronus find a way to help Apollo's team clear their names.

videos.title: Acquiring Intel
videos.overview: Eros begins breaking down Nyx’s wall in a bid to acquire intel on Priam’s schemes. Selene sets her sights on Cali after failing to get information about the Iron Heart project from Aphro.

videos.title: Track Down
videos.overview: Despite successfully luring Nyx into spending time with him, Eros struggles to obtain any information about Priam and his project. Apollo and his team race against time as an oblivious Cronus gets tracked down by Echo's men.

videos.title: Cutting the Chase
videos.overview: Apollo orders his team to retreat when Echo arrives with the intent of finishing him off once and for all. Desperate for information, Selene resorts to intimidation as she coerces Kali to divulge everything about Priam's Iron Heart project.

videos.title: Closing In
videos.overview: Apollo's team heads back to their headquarters after rescuing Cronus, unaware that Adonis is following their trail after putting a tracker on Juno's car. Later, Apollo is left frustrated after a meeting with Menandro about their next move.

videos.title: Hyperion Vaccine
videos.overview: While Priam boasts about the Hyperion vaccine’s efficacy to the Tish representative, Apollo's team gears up for their mission to infiltrate the Iron Heart project laboratory. Eros continues his efforts to gain Nyx's trust.

videos.title: Access Denied
videos.overview: As part of his mission to get information about the Iron Heart project, Eros puts a bugging device on Nyx’s bag. Things are going smoothly until Priam’s aide heads to his lab and sets off the alarm, inevitably putting the Apollo 5’s mission in peril.

videos.title: Disclosure
videos.overview: Nyx attempts to convince Priam of her innocence and loyalty without exposing Eros' true color. The Apollo 5 finds out the truth about the Iron Heart project, oblivious to the danger lurking around them.

videos.title: Target Point
videos.overview: Adonis finally finds the Apollo 5's headquarters. Apollo strikes a deal with Kali to know Tatsulok's next moves. A violent and emotional confrontation ensues between Eros and Nyx.

videos.title: Another Cover Blown
videos.overview: Eros fights for his life against Romulo's men after getting exposed as the other snitch. Apollo's team steps right into Adonis’ explosive trap. Priam orders Aphro to get rid of Kali.

videos.title: Sustained Injuries
videos.overview: Apollo and his team manage to get out of their headquarters alive, but Adonis remains determined in finishing them off. Nyx goes back to Priam, ready to receive her punishment. Aphro struggles to obey Engineer's command.

videos.title: Heightened Emotions
videos.overview: Emotions get the best of Apollo as he talks to Menandro and Eros about their course of action to stop Tatsulok's destructive project, forcing the CIB head to make a crucial decision. Priam orders his trusted soldiers to eliminate Eros.

videos.title: Pushing Through
videos.overview: Despite learning of Apollo's growing doubts about the CIB director, Eros tries to persuade Menandro to keep the former agent a part of their mission. Priam rejoices as he inches closer to reaching his goal of world domination.

videos.title: Aphro's Destruction
videos.overview: Driven by her conscience and worry over her sister, Kali discloses Tatsulok's next moves to Apollo. The Apollo 5 then races against time to stop Priam's wicked plot to spread the hyperion virus all over the world.

videos.title: An Angry Outburst
videos.overview: Apollo's team rushes to rescue Kali and the people trapped inside the Tatsulok lab. However, their mission proves to be challenging as Priam moves to destroy every piece of evidence of his evil project.

videos.title: Thwarting an Evil Plan
videos.overview: Eros confronts Menandro for leaving the Apollo 5 helpless against Priam's schemes. Later, Kali and Apollo's team try to stop the virus from spreading by contacting Karen, unaware that Engineer and his soldiers are tracking the subject's movements.

videos.title: Sitio Tartaros
videos.overview: While Selene's and Orcus' groups track down Karen, the Apollo 5 wastes no time in getting to Conrad. Later, a gunfight ensues when Apollo's team encounters Tatsulok.

videos.title: Infected
videos.overview: Apollo and Eros find themselves fighting against familiar faces upon coming across their former colleagues in Tatsulok. Kali finally manages to communicate with Karen, but unfortunate news gets in the way of their reunion.

videos.title: Unwavering Resolve
videos.overview: Apollo resolves to honor his vow to protect the lives of innocent people as he rejects Eros’ rational yet heartless suggestion to stop the spread of the Hyperion virus. Priam tells Nyx why he is not letting Selene handle the Iron Heart project.

videos.title: Race Against Escape
videos.overview: With the help of Penelope's team, Kali continues her attempts to recreate the Hyperion virus vaccine. Bent on getting to Argovia, Conrad disregards the Apollo 5's warnings and tries to escape.

videos.title: Viral Tensions
videos.overview: Apollo's life is put at risk after trying to stop Conrad from leaving the country. Priam soon learns of the incident and orders his men to keep a close eye on the infected subjects.

videos.title: Battling Infection
videos.overview: Apollo's team and the scientists working on the vaccine receive much-needed assistance from the government. Apollo still shows no symptoms of the Hyperion virus despite Conrad and Karen’s worsening state, leaving Kali baffled.

videos.title: Love, Loss, and Looming Shadows
videos.overview: Venus' overwhelming concern for Apollo forces her to confess her feelings, oblivious to an enemy's prying eyes in the shadows. Things take a turn for the worse as the virus takes a toll on Conrad.

videos.title: Aries dela Torre
videos.overview: Eros, Venus, and Poseidon begin connecting the dots upon learning that Apollo tested negative for the Hyperion virus. Hector pays his nephew a visit, leaving an envelope containing shocking information about the fate of a baby named Aries dela Torre.

videos.title: Saving Venus
videos.overview: Despite the recent revelations, Apollo delights in Kali's discovery that his blood could be the answer to their problems. Later, however, an enemy seeking revenge finds the perfect person to use against Apollo.

videos.title: Revelations and Rescues
videos.overview: Apollo looks for a way to save Venus from the brutal contraption Adonis made in the name of vengeance. Juno and Poseidon break out in a cold sweat as the spread of the Hyperion virus looms over the horizon.

videos.title: Priam's Firstborn
videos.overview: While Menandro tries to stop the Hyperion virus from spreading outside Hellas, Priam safely arrives in Italy before his trip to Tish. His smooth-sailing journey, however, makes a shocking turn when he receives Diana’s last audio log.

videos.title: Father and Son Moment
videos.overview: Apollo reaches out to Priam as he takes advantage of his blood relationship with him, hoping to put an end to the Hyperion virus crisis. Menandro senses something amiss upon learning that Apollo has flown to Italy.

videos.title: Conflict and Contagion
videos.overview: Setting foot in Italy, Apollo begins to doubt Priam’s intentions when two suspicious men attempt to seize him. Another soul succumbs to the Hyperion virus as the Philippine government ramps up its efforts to contain the contagion.

videos.title: Deception and Pursuit
videos.overview: While Apollo falls victim to deceitful Italian goons, Eros and Menandro arrive in Italy to join the search for Engineer and his son. A misunderstanding between Nyx and Romulo leads to a violent confrontation. Selene demands the truth from Priam.

videos.title: Crossroads of Destiny
videos.overview: Orcus and Selene abduct Venus and Kali. Juno faints while attending to Poseidon. Priam resolves to delay his trip to Tish in a bid to meet up with Apollo, unaware that Eros and Menandro are following his son.

videos.title: Clashing Loyalties
videos.overview: Priam’s reunion with his long-lost son escalates into a gunfight when Apollo rejects his offer to join his side. Panic creeps into Selene’s psyche when Venus tells her that she is already infected with the Hyperion virus.

videos.title: A Son's Stand, A Father's Death
videos.overview: While Selene makes her stand, Juno and Poseidon cling to the hope that Apollo will succeed in finding a cure for Hyperion. Apollo's steadfast resolve, however, pushes Priam to do the unthinkable, until Eros intervenes.

videos.title: Mission Accomplished
videos.overview: Apollo and Eros finally accomplish their mission to defeat Priam and secure the vaccine. While the CIB celebrates its success, Apollo chooses to live a simple life with his family. Meanwhile, Hector attends a religious gathering.

videos.title: A New Chapter Begins
videos.overview: Turning a new leaf, Apollo spends quality time with his loved ones and prepares to look for a normal job. Selene vows to bring Tatsulok back to its former glory. A hooded man gets congratulated for bringing down Priam and his organization.

videos.title: Altare
videos.overview: While carefully taking a look at the police operation that interrupted his meetup with Troy and Cronus, Apollo notices a strange card lying on the ground, unaware that the item’s appearance is a quick prelude to danger for both his allies and foes.

videos.title: Commando
videos.overview: Harmonia warns Menandro that Altare, the world’s largest transnational crime organization, has arrived in the Philippines. Orcus is subjected to an unconventional torture method. A cautious Juno asks Apollo to meet her privately.

videos.title: Juno's Tragic End
videos.overview: While Apollo grows extremely worried for her, Juno encounters the man who kidnapped Orcus. Despite knowing fully well that it could be a trap, Selene prepares to rescue the abducted Tatsulok member.

videos.title: Lost Evidence and Silent Secrets
videos.overview: Apollo notices a group of strange men fleeing the scene moments after Juno’s fall. Selene and her underlings step into a trap as they look for Orcus. Eros resolves to investigate his old ally’s untimely demise.

videos.title: Defiant Resolve
videos.overview: Apollo and Eros begin to investigate Juno's case. Selene ends up joining Orcus in captivity and soon faces their eccentric captor. Apollo finally meets Brother Joseph, whose accessory immediately catches the former's eye.

videos.title: Fate's Web
videos.overview: Atlas comes up with a brutal way to force Selene, Orcus, and Dylan to join his side. After getting acquainted with Brother Joseph, Apollo grows concerned upon learning that Hector is planning to donate all his properties to Yusebeia.

videos.title: The Face Behind
videos.overview: During the CIB’s operation against Atlas’ group, Xenon is left in disbelief upon being greeted by a familiar face before meeting his end. Apollo receives a warning from one of Yusebeia’s devotees following Hector’s anointing ceremony.

videos.title: Puzzling Passing and Machinations
videos.overview: Determined to fight Atlas' group for Priam's memory, Selene decides to seek help from a former ally. Brother Joseph takes matters into his own hands as Apollo begins to investigate Yusebeia. Eros gets a new assignment from Menandro.

videos.title: Double Cross
videos.overview: Upon hearing Menandro’s thoughts on Juno’s demise, Harmonia resolves to recruit Apollo to be part of her mission to bring down Altare. Selene plans to use Eros against Atlas’ group, unaware of the trap she is about to step into.

videos.title: Tensions Rise
videos.overview: Orcus arrives just in time to give Selene an opportunity to escape from Eros and the CIB. Confirming that Apollo is sniffing around Yusebeia, Joseph puts a hit on the former secret agent.

videos.title: Unraveling Suspicions
videos.overview: Apollo’s suspicions about Yusebeia grows after the failed attempt on his life. Troy struggles to juggle his job and studies as he tries to fill the role Hector left behind. Nyx escapes out of prison.

videos.title: Promise of a Good News
videos.overview: Before heading out to accomplish a secret mission, Nyx promises Selene that she will return with a good news. Apollo learns from Kules that Koa knows a lot of things about Yusebeia.

videos.title: Yusebia's Secret
videos.overview: Apollo and Kules' investigation begins to bear fruit as they stumble upon Cora's remains. Just when he decides against seeking additional security measures for Yusebeia, Joseph receives an unexpected call from the police.

videos.title: Whispers from the Dead
videos.overview: Eros urges Apollo to distance himself and his family from Yusebeia, but to no avail. After punishing Koa for his recklessness, Joseph threatens Hector with expulsion if the former undercover agent continues to meddle with their affairs.

videos.title: Unexpected Alliances
videos.overview: Suspecting that his parents ended up like Cora, Kules undergoes DNA matching with the bones found in Yusebeia. Nyx meets up with Dylan, unaware that the latter is working with Eros. Koa and his men capture Apollo.

videos.title: Captured and Confronted
videos.overview: Joseph reassures Eros that he has control over the whole situation involving Apollo, until the ex-CIB agent fights back. A scuffle ensues between Nyx and Dylan when the latter makes his intentions known.

videos.title: Tides of Deceit
videos.overview: After seeing Joseph’s true color, Apollo fights tooth and nail as he tries to escape from Yusebeia’s private army. Kules fumes with rage upon finding his mother’s scarf among the pieces of evidence found in the mass grave.

videos.title: Captive Secrets
videos.overview: Eros chances upon Nyx. A furious Kules confronts Hera about his parents' deaths, resulting in a bloody altercation between them when the whole truth spills out. Menandro carries out confidential fieldwork.

videos.title: Of Captive and Clue
videos.overview: Priam names his price for revealing the things he knows about Altare. Joseph accuses Apollo of murdering Hera. One of Engineer’s puzzles leads Nyx to his lawyer.

videos.title: Conspiracy Unraveled
videos.overview: Koa and his men ambush Apollo, only to be driven off by another group that aims to abduct their target. Orcus gets clobbered by Atlas for refusing to spill Selene’s whereabouts. Eros urges Joseph to distance himself from Apollo, but to no avail.

videos.title: The Heir
videos.overview: Apollo gets the shock of his life when he meets Priam once again for an absurd assignment. Unbeknownst to the former CIB agent, Joseph finds a way to settle the score with him as the Yusebeia leader publicly accuses him of killing Hera.

videos.title: Crimson Pursuit
videos.overview: Apollo storms Joseph’s mansion as he searches for Lia. Selene fumes as she hears the contents of Engineer’s last will and testament. Keeping his end of the bargain, Priam reveals to Menandro the things he knows about Altare.

videos.title: Fugitive
videos.overview: By orders of Brother Joseph, Koa ambushes Kules. Hector tries to convince the Yusebeia leader of his nephew's innocence. As news of Apollo's involvement in Hera's death reaches him, Menandro orders Eros to arrest their former agent.

videos.title: Dawn of a New Era
videos.overview: An intense chase ensues when Menandro and Eros try to apprehend Apollo. Troy and Cronus get in trouble as they search for Lia. A new era dawns on Tatsulok as it cleans up its ranks, summons its loyal members, and welcomes its new leader.

videos.title: Ascending to Power
videos.overview: Selene questions Apollo’s loyalty and leadership, only to be faced with the threat of being marked as Tatsulok’s enemy. Dylan pledges his loyalty to Commando. A group of attractive ladies abducts Kules.

videos.title: Entangled Loyalties
videos.overview: Vowing vengeance for Lia's fate, Apollo mobilizes Tatsulok to take down Yusebeia and even the score with Brother Joseph. Harmonia gets ambushed by a group of unknown men, but help arrives in the nick of time.

videos.title: The Hidden Brew
videos.overview: After uncovering how Brother Joseph keeps his devotees faithful, Apollo and Tatsulok prepare for an all-out attack against Yusebeia. Hector’s pleas fall on deaf ears as he urges the police to investigate what happened to Lia.

videos.title: Thanksgiving Mess
videos.overview: Apollo, Orcus, and Romulo infiltrate Yusebeia in an attempt to abduct Brother Joseph. Eros grows alarmed when an anonymous tip alleging Yusebeia's illegal activities prompts the CIB to launch an investigation.

videos.title: Rings of Fate
videos.overview: Brother Joseph flees from Yusebeia and heads to his safe house where he is keeping his captive. While batting Altare’s men, Apollo recalls the day Juno died upon seeing Atlas’ ring.

videos.title: Deep Ties
videos.overview: Eros and his subordinates resolve to punish Brother Joseph for violating the Altare code. Lia remains in captivity while her family prepares to relocate. Apollo finds an opportunity to gain information on Atlas’ connection with the sect leader.
